name: Fathom iOS app
desc: iPhone app that records in-person conversations, not just calls.
desc_zh: 能录线下对话而不只是线上会议的 iPhone 应用
solves: Fathom only worked when a meeting ran on your computer. The iOS app captures conversations in the room and keeps the summaries on your phone.
solves_zh: 以前只有会议在电脑上进行时才能用上 Fathom。iOS 应用能录下现场对话，并把摘要留在手机上。
best_for: The conversation that matters is a hallway one and nobody is going to transcribe it later.
best_for_zh: 真正重要的谈话发生在走廊上，而事后没人会去整理它的文字稿。
